Based on my analysis of the problem, the issue is that `generateObject` with `mode: 'tool'` fails with certain providers (like Anthropic through the gateway) because the model responds with plain text instead of making a tool call, and the code then tries to parse that text as JSON.

The most likely files that need to be edited to fix this issue are:

```
packages/ai/core/generate-object/generate-object.ts
packages/ai/core/generate-object/output-strategy.ts
packages/gateway/src/gateway-language-model.ts
packages/ai/core/generate-object/inject-json-instruction.ts
packages/gateway/src/gateway-provider.ts
```
